actions.action: Backup ground handling contract at both bases for the strike days
Extra airport and call-center staff for 2 weeks
Free changes and cancellations for bookings in a 2-week window

decisions.message: Workers at our ground handling contractor plan a 48-hour strike in Orlando and Philadelphia on December 22-23. We have hired backup ground crews at both airports and added airport and call-center staff. If you fly with us between December 14 and 27, you can change or cancel your booking free of charge in the app. We will text you if your flight changes.
decisions.why:
Cut strike-day cancellations at the source (backup crews).
Keep rebooking within 24h with more staff on the phones.
Let worried travelers move dates before the strike, free.

actions.action: Rebooking deal with a partner airline for 2 disrupted weeks
Hotel rooms held for stranded passengers, whatever the cause

decisions.message: If your Kestrel flight is canceled or badly delayed during the strike, we will rebook you on Kestrel or a partner airline, and we are holding hotel rooms for anyone stranded overnight, whatever the cause. You can always choose a refund instead if your flight is canceled or significantly delayed. Check the app for your options.
decisions.why:
Get stranded holiday travelers moving within 24h.
Remove the worst outcome: a night in the airport.
State refund rights plainly; they are not a favor.

customer_mix._note: TEAM ASSUMPTION, share of Kestrel passengers by group (no public split: research section 5 [GAP]). Dossier: 'Price-conscious travelers: families visiting relatives, students, vacationers, and some small business travelers' plus agencies booking group tickets. Families first (holiday season, Christmas week 97% booked), vacationers next, students on winter break, 'some' business, agencies small but each books a whole group. Shares are passengers, not bookings. Each persona weighs its group's share split evenly over that group's personas.
